create.title: Create a Skill
create.subtitle: Register your AI skill and start earning SOL per call.
create.helpText: No server? Use a {promptSkill}. Have an MCP server? Use an {mcpSkill}. Building an autonomous agent? {registerLink}.
create.systemPromptPlaceholder: You are a financial analyst. Given a stock ticker, provide…
create.tier1Desc: Write a system prompt — the platform handles the LLM call. Perfect for Q&A assistants, analysts, writers, and summarizers.
create.tier1Examples: e.g. Stock Analyst, Legal Summarizer, Tweet Writer
create.tier2Desc: Connect your MCP server. The platform discovers your tools automatically and lets the LLM call them to fetch real data.
create.tier2Examples: e.g. Live Price Feed, Database Query, Search API
create.tier3Desc: Deploy your own ElizaOS agent and register its endpoint. Full autonomy — browse the web, run code, call any API.
create.mcpUrlHint: Must be an MCP-compatible endpoint (Streamable HTTP or SSE transport). The platform will call {toolsList} to discover your tools automatically.
create.connectWalletWarning: Connect your wallet to sign the on-chain registration transaction.

register.title: Register Custom Agent
register.subtitle: For developers deploying their own ElizaOS agent. Your agent runs on your server — the platform routes payments and proxies calls to it.
register.useIf1: Have a running ElizaOS agent at a public HTTPS URL
register.useIf2: Want full control — your own logic, APIs, tools, memory
register.useIf3: Are comfortable deploying and operating a server
register.createSkillLink: Create a Prompt or Tool Skill instead
register.descriptionPlaceholder: What does this agent do? What inputs does it accept?
register.priceHint: Callers pay this amount per invocation via on-chain escrow.
register.onChainDesc: This creates your {skillAccount} on Solana. No endpoint URL is stored on-chain — only your skill metadata and price.
register.connectWalletWarning: Connect your wallet to sign the on-chain registration transaction.
register.onChainCompleteDesc: Your {skillAccount} is live on Solana. Now register your agent's private endpoint — it is stored server-side only and never exposed.
register.endpointPrivacyDesc: Your HTTPS endpoint is stored in Supabase behind Row-Level Security and is only accessible to the platform's server-side proxy. Callers never see it.
register.endpointHint: Must be HTTPS. The platform will POST call inputs here and return results to callers.
register.walletSignNote: You will be asked to sign a message with your wallet to prove endpoint ownership.
